scopeLimits: Translate only rulebook instructions in Tables 11 and 13; cards and other game components remain original.
Titles, steps, indented substeps, explanatory paragraphs and notes are separate PT-BR units.
T11 and T13 keep their exact English fidelity overlays in EN. PT-BR hides only those source-art overlays and uses PageRenderer units over a cleaned localized background.
Semantic icons in PT-BR are inline data segments: dice.black, combat.shield.solid and combat.page.
SOI and quoted card wording remain source language; no glossary-wide term is approved by this proposal.

candidates.sourceText: To make a Conviction Check, each figure targeted by the Spell rolls the Conviction dice printed on their card. If the total number rolled is equal to or greater than the Spell’s Force Value, the Spell is resisted by that figure. However, if the roll is less than the Force Value of the Spell, the Spell’s printed effects occur. Once every target has rolled a Conviction Check, the Spell Action ends.
candidates.proposalText: Para fazer um Teste de Convicção, cada Miniatura visada pelo Feitiço rola os Dados de Convicção impressos na sua ficha ou carta. Se o total obtido for igual ou maior que o Valor de Força do Feitiço, essa Miniatura resiste aos efeitos. Se o resultado for menor, ocorrem os efeitos impressos do Feitiço. Quando todos os alvos tiverem feito o Teste de Convicção, a Ação de Feitiço termina.

candidates.sourceText: Each target that failed their Conviction Check resolves the spell's effects separately and in the order they made the Conviction Check. This could be Magic Damage determined by a roll, Negative Effects such as Poison, or manipulating their position on a Tile. A Spell's effects are described on the Ability that started the Spell Action after, "Cast a SPELL (X)".

Eles estão descritos na Habilidade que iniciou a Ação de Feitiço, após “Cast a SPELL (X)”.
